title: The Wolf and the Lion
summary: A wolf dragged a slaughtered lamb from the fold and was hauling it into his mountain lair when a lion leaped out, struck him down, and snatched the carcass between his jaws....
full_text:
Beside a cool mountain stream where wild plane trees offered shelter from the summer heat, A wolf dragged a slaughtered lamb from the fold and was hauling it into his mountain lair when a lion leaped out, struck him down, and snatched the carcass between his jaws..... The creatures of the field went about their daily lives according to their nature, each seeking their own advantage while keeping a vigilant watch over friends and foes alike.

As the hours passed, an unexpected turning point arose that tested their wits and character. A tense confrontation soon arose as rival desires crossed paths under the midday sun. Words were exchanged with cautious cunning, glances were measured, and each party sought to disguise their true intentions behind a veil of outward innocence.

Yet the timeless laws of nature cannot be deceived by clever words or false appearances. Natural instincts and sharp wits collided, bringing the trial to an immediate, decisive climax.  The outcome was swift and irreversible, leaving behind a lasting lesson for all who witnessed the event, proving that a thief has no right to cry robbery when a mightier thief takes his plunder.
moral: A thief has no right to cry robbery when a mightier thief takes his plunder.
